card.name: Linking words in election-rule text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, from, to, is) and some verbs in the middle of a clause, mostly in passages on voting rules and elections. It also fires on a few similar spots in other prose.

modes.label: Voting-rule changes
modes.description: Linking word or verb inside a phrase about changing election systems or voting laws.
modes.example: wants to move away from single-member districts to an at-large election, as several tried to do to reduce the voting strength of racial minorities, or change<< the>> voting

modes.label: Other mid-clause words
modes.description: Linking words or verbs in the middle of history or science prose, where a noun phrase is expected next.
modes.example: The Donskoy cemetery became one of the most prestigious in Moscow as the great families of the<< city>> came to use the cemetery.
